concerns.text: The specification defines no Success Criteria (SC-*) identifiers. Without SCs, the task list cannot be linked to measurable verification targets, leaving a gap in the requirements traceability.

None of the contract schema files (e.g., data_tuple.schema.yaml, evaluation_metrics.schema.yaml, etc.) are referenced by any task via tags or description. Each contract should have at least one task that produces or validates the corresponding artifact.

The plan mentions a quickstart guide (quickstart.md) but no tasks are linked to the steps described there. Quickstart steps must be covered by implementation tasks to ensure end‑to‑end reproducibility.
